title: Cheap Carbon, Expensive Option: What China's ETS Costs a Steel Plant Today, and in 2040
detail: China's carbon market now covers steel, cement and aluminium at about US$12 a tonne; the ClimRisk engine shows what the same plants face if the price follows the NGFS scenarios instead.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
